quest.title: Crossing Unknown Storm Clouds
quest.description: The task of locating Ruin machines is almost complete, but one thing continues to trouble Muzhen...
quest.rewards_formatted: Primogem x50, Hero's Wit x2, Mora x20000

dialogues.speaker: Muzhen
dialogues.text: Thanks to the clues you brought back, I'm now able to pinpoint the location of the Ruin machines.

dialogues.speaker: Muzhen
dialogues.text: However, we need to take care of a little problem before we do that...

dialogues.speaker: Muzhen
dialogues.text: There are some Electro anomalies nearby that are interfering with the tracking process. I'll give you the locations of these anomalies... Please, get rid of them.

dialogues.speaker: Muzhen
dialogues.text: Just as before, I'll need you to bring some samples back... Firstly, to study how I might use them.

dialogues.speaker: Muzhen
dialogues.text: And secondly... well, we are a merchant fleet, after all. We've got to see if they've got any commercial worth, of course!

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: And how are your studies going on that front?

dialogues.speaker: Muzhen
dialogues.text: Hmm... The samples that you've given me, if properly used, might give The Crux Fleet a new way of dodging thunderstorms with ease that doesn't rely on our mobility.

dialogues.speaker: Muzhen
dialogues.text: If so, it would make our commercial route to and from Inazuma much more secure, and we would have more guaranteed efficiency.

dialogues.speaker: Muzhen
dialogues.text: However, seeing as the Sakoku Decree is the Shogun's will, such actions may displease her...

dialogues.speaker: Muzhen
dialogues.text: So of course, the most direct result of our research is that we can use the "age" and "life" of these anomalous Electro growths to determine the size and origin of Electro anomalies.

dialogues.speaker: Muzhen
dialogues.text: These origins, of course, are the targets we're looking for: the ancient, mysterious Ruin organisms!

dialogues.speaker: Muzhen
dialogues.text: Hehe, sorry, got a little carried away there...

dialogues.speaker: Muzhen
dialogues.text: Well then. This is the final stretch. Let's get going!

talks.objective: Go to the Electro anomaly and complete the challenge
